svg.title: EMQX event-driven architecture
svg.desc: Event-driven architecture for EMQX: MQTT producers publish messages to topics; EMQX broker routes to subscribed consumers; rule engine reacts to matching messages and forwards to bridges and backend integrations. Producers and consumers fully decoupled through topic-based pub/sub and asynchronous delivery.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do IoT sensors publish MQTT messages to EMQX?')

sendPrompt('How do backend services publish events to EMQX?')

svg.text: Producers never call consumer logic directly — fully decoupled through MQTT topics, subscriptions, rule engine, and async delivery
